e107Plugin.name: Github Sync Lite
e107Plugin.summary: Lightweight core + selective-plugin sync from a GitHub repo (Lite).
e107Plugin.description: Downloads the Lite core from a GitHub repo and, from the same archive, only the plugin folders you selected (selective plugin sync — the selection is saved in the plugin settings; the rest of the repo's plugins folder is skipped). The source repo layout (eplugins vs e107_plugins, "e" vs "e107_" folder prefix) is configurable. Uses its own copy of the sync engine; no database table, no dependency on the full githubSync plugin.
